planning_notes: Only explicitly provided wiring is LM35 analog input on A2; no other ports (GPIO/PWM/servos/etc.) are required by the provided requirements inventory.
LM35 conversion from ADC counts to °C, any filtering/averaging, and the serial report cadence are model responsibilities (not implemented here).
A serial fixed-prefix text line request is included with text="TEMP_C="; the program-owned gate controls printing this exact fixed text when the corresponding report trigger fires.

Serial channel uses baud=9600 and framing is assumed consistent with the provided configuration (line_or_idle, idle_timeout_ms=20). The exact output line composition is assumed to be: fixed text prefix followed by the f64 temperature value (format controlled in the SysML model).
No electrical calibration (scale/offset) is specified for the analog input; analog_input uses catalog defaults for scale/offset (model performs LM35 °C conversion instead).
